infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ink uses your camera so you can take photos and videos to share with your friends.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Ink uses your microphone so you can record audio for videos and voice notes.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Ink needs access to your photos so you can upload them to your feed or chat.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Ink uses your location to show you people and posts nearby.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Ink uses your contacts to help you find friends who are already using the app.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Ink to access your photos so you can share them.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Ink to use your camera to take new photos and videos.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Ink to use your location to find nearby people.
